review_candidates.description: Software Developer Location: Remote - Anywhere in Canada Please note the base salary will be determined by the successful candidate's education, skills and experience. The listed salary range serves as a general pay guideline for this position's pay level. Our hiring process includes AI screening for keywords and minimum qualifications. Recruiters review all results. The total target compensation (TTC) range, including salary and target bonus, is $91,080 - $141,080. This TTC range is applicable to permanent roles only. The base salary offered within this range will be determined by the successful candidate’s skills and experience, as well as internal equity. Empire Life is looking to hire a Software Developer to join our Back Office Development team! We are actively seeking candidates to fill a current, open position. We are building a dedicated modernization development team to transform our core operational systems from legacy COBOL and Easytrieve mainframe logic into a modern, cloud-native architecture using Incremental Modernization Strategy patterns. Why pursue this opportunity Impactful work - get the opportunity to work on meaningful projects that have a positive impact on our customers, our company, and society as a whole. Play an integral role - this is an opportunity that allows for you to grow your skills, while directly contributing to the business unit you are a part of. The opportunity - collaborate with cross-functional teams and work on a variety of projects that will keep you engaged and continuously learning. Diversity, equity, and inclusion - we are committed to creating a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace and welcome candidates who share this commitment. What you’ll be working on Technical Discovery & Code Analysis: Reading COBOL programs, Easytrieve report scripts, and JCL flows to reverse-engineer core business rules and data pipelines. Target Architecture & Service Development: Writing clean, scalable microservices/APIs in modern target languages (e.g., Java/Kotlin, C#, Python, or Go) and decoupling batch workflows into event streams (Kafka). Parity Testing & Interception: Setting up API routing gateways, feature flags, and parallel shadow testing to validate that new services match legacy output down to the penny/byte before cutting over. Implementation & Cleanup: Flipping live transaction switches and safely decommissioning legacy system functions and capabilities. What we’re looking for you to have 1+ years work experience in back office software development. Practical working knowledge and expertise in application modernization. Completion of a University degree, college diploma, technical training, and/or equivalent experience. Reverse engineering & legacy logic (COBOL/Easytrieve) analysis. Understanding of incremental modernization patterns. Hands-on expertise in modern target languages and frameworks (Java/Kotlin, Golang, Python, C#). Expertise in data layer migration from hierarchical/flat formats to relational or NoSQL stores Mainframe ecosystem working knowledge (JCL, CICS, VSAM, DB2, packed-decimal). Experience with test driven validation, automated parity and parallel testing. Ability to map monolithic batch/transactional workflows to event-driven architectures. Domain-Driven Design (DDD) & monolith decomposition. Modern CI/CD pipelines. Risk management & defensive modernization mindset. GCP and/or Microsoft Azure experience for modernization would be an asset. Insurance or investment experience would be an asset. If you are applying for a position which is open to applicants across Canada, unless otherwise indicated in the position, language proficiency in English is required for communicating with customers, advisors, or employees across Canada. Beyond the salary For permanent full-time positions, Empire Life offers a comprehensive total rewards package that includes: Competitive salaries with annual pay increases Annual bonus program, which recognizes both strong company performance and individual contributions, for non sales positions Competitive uncapped commission, for sales positions A comprehensive employer-funded benefits package starting from day one of employment, that includes life insurance, disability, health and dental and a generous health account Flexible work arrangements and an annual allotment of personal health days. Four weeks annual vacation from hire date A defined contribution pension plan with generous employer matching Top up programs for parental leave and compassionate leave Employer-sponsored wellness and recognition programs A cash employee referral program To learn more about working at Empire Life, visit https://www.empire.ca/workatempire . Get to know us Empire life is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity, are committed to creating an inclusive environment, and welcome everyone to participate in our application process. We encourage those of all backgrounds and experiences to apply, even if you don't believe you meet each unique qualification outlined. Applicants will receive equal consideration without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, or age. Empire Life welcomes applications from people with disabilities and disabled people. Accommodations are available upon request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the screening and selection process. If you need this job posting in an alternative format or have any accessibility questions, please contact recruitment@empire.ca .

review_candidates.title: Senior Software Engineer
review_candidates.description: Company Overview At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. We’re a global close-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. We build and connect technologies to help protect people, property and places. Our solutions foster the collaboration that’s critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals, safer businesses, and ultimately, safer nations. Connect with a career that matters, and help us build a safer future. Department Overview Interface Job Description As a Senior Software Engineer on our interface team, you will design, build, and maintain mission-critical interfaces connecting our core product suite - including Computer-Aided Dispatch (CAD), Records Management Systems (RMS), Real-Time Command & Control, and Analytics with critical third-party systems. You will own the end-to-end integration lifecycle: architecting resilient Extract, Transform, Load (ETL) pipelines, developing custom adapters, and building transformation layers that handle field mapping, schema validation, and real-time business logic. You will partner closely with Solution Architects and Product Managers to turn complex client specifications into robust, scalable software interfaces. Key Responsibilities Integration Architecture & Delivery: Architect, build, and deploy secure, high-throughput inbound and outbound integration pipelines connecting on-premise, hybrid, and cloud-hosted systems. Technical Solutioning & Estimation: Collaborate with Product Managers, Solution Architects, and customer-facing teams to analyze interface requirements, validate technical feasibility, and provide accurate scoping and level-of-effort (LOE) estimates. Pipeline & API Development: Design and implement resilient RESTful APIs, webhook receivers, and event-driven data adapters using ETL/data-streaming design patterns. Code Quality & Best Practices: Establish engineering standards, drive code reviews, champion automated unit/integration testing, and maintain comprehensive interface design documentation. Mentorship & Technical Leadership: Mentor mid-level and junior engineers, foster engineering best practices, and guide the team toward modern, scalable architectural paradigms. Operational Excellence: Build observability into interfaces (logging, tracing, metrics, alerting) to ensure rapid diagnosis and high availability across production deployments. Basic Requirements Basic Qualifications Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field (or equivalent practical experience). 7+ years of professional software development experience building enterprise-grade, distributed applications. 5+ years of deep backend development experience with C# / .NET (.NET Core / .NET 6+ preferred). Proven expertise in API & Interface Design: Designing, documenting, and implementing production REST APIs, webhooks, and asynchronous integration patterns. Demonstrated experience with ETL architectures, data transformations, field mapping engines, or enterprise integration patterns (EIP). Favorable Qualifications Public Safety & Critical Systems: Prior domain experience with CAD, 911 dispatch, RMS, or real-time event streaming systems. Strong proficiency in Relational and non-Relational Databases & SQL (complex query design, indexing, schema design, and performance optimization). Cloud & Containers: Hands-on experience developing and deploying services in Azure or GCP, utilizing Docker and Kubernetes. Polyglot & Scripting Experience: Proficiency in secondary enterprise stacks or scripting languages (e.g., Node.js, TypeScript/JavaScript, Java, or Python). Modern Messaging & Event Streaming: Experience with message brokers and event buses (e.g., RabbitMQ, Apache Kafka, Azure Service Bus, or AWS SQS). CI/CD & DevOps: Familiarity with Git workflows, automated testing frameworks, and continuous delivery pipelines. Travel Requirements None Relocation Provided None Position Type Experienced Referral Payment Plan Yes EEO Statement Motorola Solutions is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion or belief, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status or any other legally-protected characteristic. We are proud of our people-first and community-focused culture, empowering every Motorolan to be their most authentic self and to do their best work to deliver on the promise of a safer world. If you’d like to join our team but feel that you don’t quite meet all of the preferred skills, we’d still love to hear why you think you’d be a great addition to our team.
